_source: Observed drop rates from data/az1_pack_loot_tables.csv of https://github.com/Theveninm/Hex-shard-of-fates-revival (community data, no license stated). Weights are the observed '% Drop Chance' values; the server normalises them per list.
_comment: Generated by AssetExtraction/import_pack_loot_tables.py; do not edit by hand. Keyed by chest template GUID. 'equipment' is the per-slot pool (each pack has two slots); 'unique' marks the dungeon's exclusive pieces.
